description: Script slot actions: reload (recompile prog/N.txt; id 0 = all), run (run once now, even if disabled), enable / disable (RAM only until reload/restart; persist=true also rewrites #enabled in the file), delete (removes prog/N.txt, needs MYIO_WRITE=config). Editor/admin level.
name: myio_script
title: Run / switch / delete a script
